scope: Proposed weak training-sidecar semantics only; no model or canonical behavior change

contextDefinitions.financial_notice: Text functions as an account/wallet/card activity or status report, including balance-only or declined-event notices. This describes wording, not authenticated origin.
contextDefinitions.personal_conversation: Interpersonal discussion or claim, even if a speaker claims that money moved. An accompanying request to check does not turn that claim into a financial notice.
contextDefinitions.question_or_request: Primary function is asking about a movement or requesting information/action; no independently asserted account posting governs the message.
contextDefinitions.instruction_or_example: Primary function is a lesson, illustrative quotation, simulation or procedural instruction; an embedded event is interpreted in that frame.
contextDefinitions.known_other: Clear other purpose, such as promotion or maintenance, without an independently asserted completed movement. Do not use as a catch-all for unclear context.
contextDefinitions.unknown: Context cannot be resolved, is truncated, or contains incompatible frames without a clear governing event. Missing annotation is not this label.

eventStateDefinitions.completed: Selected event is explicitly described as posted, received, deducted, credited or otherwise complete within its own frame. A personal claim or lesson can describe completion without proving an actual bank transaction.
eventStateDefinitions.not_completed: Selected event is explicitly refused, cancelled before execution, still pending, or explicitly not yet performed. A later reversal is a separate completed event, not an undone annotation of the original event.
eventStateDefinitions.no_event: Text contains no identifiable transfer/payment/credit/debit or other financial-movement proposition; e.g. balance-only or a price quotation. A bare amount is not an event.
eventStateDefinitions.unknown: A movement is mentioned but its outcome is unasserted, questioned, conditional or conflicting; do not force it to not_completed.

eventScopeRule: Mark the event clause evaluated. In a lesson evaluate its embedded event; in a question do not assume the proposition is asserted. Context describes the governing frame. In multi-event/mixed-frame text with no clear focus, hold the annotation rather than inventing a priority rule.
negationRule: Determine which clause is negated. Not pending and no refusal can accompany completed settlement; a negative word alone does not set event state.
partyRule: Control words within a party name are not automatically message-level instructions, examples or refusals. Review their grammatical scope; never use a merchant registry.
evidence: Manually selected unique raw quotes converted to Unicode code-point half-open offsets; whole-message evidence allowed for no_event or context absence. Exact original text only.
unknownVsUnreviewed: Unknown is a semantic label supported by the message. Missing/unreviewed annotation is not a negative or unknown target. Hold means unresolved annotator interpretation and is ineligible for fitting.
composition: Do not automatically replace the existing completion label with these two fields. Review disagreement; retain original truth. A conversational claim or quoted lesson may have completed describedEventState and legacy non_transaction. Financial notice plus completed is completion-compatible but does not authorize logging, prove ownership, supply amount or authenticate sender.
trainingBoundary: Labels are weak sidecars for currently selected training records only. Preserve all existing validation/reserved/final assignments, labels and raw text. No automatic propagation from one pilot record to its whole group.
